body:
# CL43: Live Activity Line and Loop Breaker on `agy`

- **Branch:** `cl43` (worktree `/home/anon/board-cl43`)
- **Commit:** `3902d1e` (`CL43: live activity line and loop breaker on agy`)
- **Files changed (12):** `kit/hook.py`, `kit/hooks/kit_activity.py`, `kit/hooks/kit_task_train.py`, `kit/hooks/test_hooks.py`, synced `.kit/` copies + `.kit/manifest.json` (via `python3 -I install.py . --update`), `test_install.py`, `tests/test_post_gate.py`, `tests/test_unified_hooks.py`.

## 1. Real `agy` Hook Payload & Output Contract (Verified Live on `agy` 1.5.17)

Inspected `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/skills/agy-customizations/docs/hooks.md`, existing agy hooks, our live subagent transcript, and ran a real `agy` 1.5.17 hook probe in `/tmp/agy-probe` capturing stdin JSON across all 6 lifecycle events (`SessionStart`, `PreInvocation`, `PreToolUse`, `PostToolUse`, `PostInvocation`, `Stop`):

- **Common stdin fields (camelCase):** `hookEventName`, `conversationId`, `cwd`, `workspacePaths`, `transcriptPath`, `artifactDirectoryPath`, `modelName`, `lastUserInput`.
- **Tool events (`PreToolUse`, `PostToolUse`):** `stepIdx`, `toolCall: {"id": "...", "name": "<tool>", "args": {...}}`, plus `error` on `PostToolUse`.
  - `run_command`: `args = {"CommandLine": "...", "toolSummary": "...", "WaitMsBeforeAsync": 5000, ...}`
  - `write_file`: `args = {"Path": "...", "Content": "..."}`
  - `edit_file`: `args = {"Path": "...", "Target": "...", "Replacement": "..."}`
  - `send_message`: `args = {"Recipient": "...", "Message": "..."}`
- **Post discovery without `KIT_POST`:**
  - `agy -p`: `transcriptPath` step 0 is `type: "USER_INPUT"` with `content` wrapped in `<USER_REQUEST>\n...\n</USER_REQUEST>`.
  - `invoke_subagent` (how `kit.py` launches agy parts): `transcriptPath` step 0 is `type: "SYSTEM_MESSAGE"` with `[Message] ... content=Your prompt is <path>/docs/prompts/<post>.md: ...` (paths may be relative or absolute).
  - Fallback: `lastUserInput` when no transcript file exists yet.
- **Loop-breaker stdout contract (critical live finding):**
  - `agy` `PostToolUse` expects `{}` and **ignores `injectSteps`** (probe token `PROBE_POST_TOOL_INJECT_TOKEN_999` returned from `PostToolUse` was NOT received by the model).
  - `agy` `PostInvocation` **injects `injectSteps`** (probe token `PROBE_POST_INVOC_INJECT_TOKEN_888` returned from `PostInvocation` WAS injected as `"The following system message was injected by a PostInvocation hook: ..."` and read by the model).

## 2. Changes to `kit_activity.py`, `kit_task_train.py`, and `kit/hook.py`

- **`kit/hooks/kit_task_train.py` (`_first_prompt` / `part_post`):**
  - Reads `transcriptPath` or `transcript_path`, parses Claude Code `user`, agy `USER_INPUT` (unwrapping `<USER_REQUEST>`), and agy subagent `SYSTEM_MESSAGE` (`[Message] ... content=...`), falling back to `lastUserInput`.
  - Matches both relative (`docs/prompts/<id>.md`) and absolute (`/.../docs/prompts/<id>.md`) part launch prompts while continuing to ignore reviews (`CR-*`), clerk/orchestrator prompts, and human prose mentioning prompt paths.
- **`kit/hooks/kit_activity.py`:**
  - Accepts both Claude Code (`hook_event_name`, `session_id`, `tool_name`, `tool_input`) and agy (`hookEventName`, `conversationId`/`conversation_id`, `toolCall.name`, `toolCall.args`).
  - `what_of`: `run_command` uses `toolSummary` (up to 90 chars) else `bash_words(CommandLine)`; `write_file` emits `"Writing <basename>"`, `edit_file` emits `"Editing <basename>"`, `send_message` emits `"Sending a message"`.
  - `changed_pieces`: checks `Path` / `TargetFile` / `file_path` / `notebook_path` / `path`.
  - Preserves all limits: no model call; detached `board_cli.py set activity <post>`; at most 1 write per 15 s (immediate on `Stop`, piece change, or loop detection); stdout silent except on the 8th consecutive identical call.
  - Loop breaker delivery: Claude Code emits `hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext` on `PostToolUse`; agy records `"pending"` in `.kit/run/activity/loop-<cid>.json` on `PostToolUse` (while writing `loop: 8` to `activity/<post>` immediately and keeping `PostToolUse` stdout empty) and pops/emits `{"injectSteps": [{"systemMessage": {"systemMessage": "..."}}]}` once on `PostInvocation` (preserving `"pending"` across same-invocation repeats until `PostInvocation` consumes it).
- **`kit/hook.py` (`TABLE`) & `.kit/` sync:**
  - Wired `kit_activity.py` for `"agy"` on `PreToolUse` (`run_command|edit_file|write_file`), `PostToolUse` (`run_command|edit_file|write_file|send_message`), `PostInvocation` (`ANY`), and `Stop` (`ANY`).
  - Existing unified `.agents/hooks.json` matchers already cover all four events and tools; non-unified installs emit 20 agy handlers (was 16).
  - Synced `.kit/hook.py`, `.kit/hooks/kit_activity.py`, `.kit/hooks/kit_task_train.py`, `.kit/hooks/test_hooks.py`, and `.kit/manifest.json` via `python3 -I install.py . --update`.

## 3. Verification & Test Results

All hook, parity, post-gate, copy-sync, card-push, and installer suites pass with 0 failures:

- `python3 -m unittest tests.test_post_gate -v`: **43/43 OK** (includes new `test_what_an_agy_part_does_now_reaches_its_step_with_no_model_call` covering subagent/CLI/`lastUserInput` post discovery, `toolSummary` + `bash_words` fallback, `write_file`/`edit_file` piece moves, 15 s throttling, subfolder `cwd`, `PreToolUse`, `Stop`, loop breaker via `PostToolUse` + `PostInvocation`, and non-part silence).
- `python3 -m unittest tests.test_unified_hooks -v`: **20/20 OK** (`parity agy: 60 cases, 8 stopped, 19 with text`; `parity web/cli: 200 cases, 39 stopped, 74 with text`; `TABLE` count `{"web": 30, "cli": 27, "agy": 20}`).
- `python3 -I kit/hooks/test_hooks.py`: **0 failed** (includes new agy `kit_activity.py` 8-repeat `PostToolUse` -> `PostInvocation` check).
- `python3 -I test_install.py </dev/null`: **50/50 ok, 0 failed** (checks 20 agy handlers merged into `.agents/hooks.json`).
- `python3 -m unittest tests.test_install_present_runtimes -v </dev/null`: **4/4 OK**.
- `python3 -m unittest tests.test_kit_copies_current tests.test_cl31_card_push -v`: **all OK** (confirms `.kit/` byte-copies match `kit/`).
- `python3 -m unittest tests.test_train_and_task_train -v`: **25/25 OK** (note: `test_review_prompt_is_filled_and_started_once` detects `_ancestor("agy")` when run unsandboxed under an agy parent process and passes inside the sandbox).

## 4. Live Real `agy` Part Run & Board Snapshots

Installed the updated kit (`install.py --runtime agy --cli agy --unified-hooks`) into `/tmp/cl43-live`, started a real `board_server.py` on `http://127.0.0.1:32795`, seeded step `cl43-demo-step`, and ran a real `agy` 1.5.17 session (`--model "Gemini 3.8 Flash (Low)" -p "Your prompt is docs/prompts/cl43-demo-step.md: read it and do it."`) with **no `KIT_POST` and no `KIT_ROLE` environment variables**, polling `GET /_api/db/activity/cl43-demo-step` every 2 s:

```text
AGY_STARTED pid=13687 at=2026-11-26T04:20:36Z
t= 58.9s 2026-11-26T04:21:35Z -> {"at": "2026-11-26T04:21:30Z", "actions": 0, "what": "Writing sky.md", "state": "working", "pieces": []}
t= 81.1s 2026-11-26T04:21:57Z -> {"at": "2026-11-26T04:21:55Z", "actions": 2, "what": "Wait and verify sky.md", "state": "working", "pieces": []}
t= 99.3s 2026-11-26T04:22:15Z -> {"at": "2026-11-26T04:22:10Z", "actions": 3, "what": "Loop check", "state": "working", "pieces": []}
t=111.9s 2026-11-26T04:22:28Z -> {"at": "2026-11-26T04:22:26Z", "actions": 5, "what": "Loop check", "state": "working", "pieces": []}
t=128.1s 2026-11-26T04:22:44Z -> {"at": "2026-11-26T04:22:41Z", "actions": 7, "what": "Loop check", "state": "working", "pieces": []}
t=146.7s 2026-11-26T04:23:02Z -> {"at": "2026-11-26T04:22:59Z", "actions": 9, "what": "Loop check", "state": "working", "pieces": []}
t=161.8s 2026-11-26T04:23:18Z -> {"at": "2026-11-26T04:23:14Z", "actions": 11, "what": "Loop check", "state": "working", "pieces": [], "loop": 8}
t=176.5s 2026-11-26T04:23:32Z -> {"at": "2026-11-26T04:23:28Z", "actions": 11, "what": "Loop check", "state": "stopped", "pieces": []}
AGY_EXIT rc=0
```

On the 8th consecutive identical `run_command` (`actions: 11`), `loop: 8` appeared immediately on `activity/cl43-demo-step`, and the real `agy` session received the injected `PostInvocation` system message, stopped repeating, and quoted it verbatim:

> "The same run_command call, with the same input, 8 times in a row: it is not getting anywhere. Change the approach, or stop and say in your post what blocks you."

## 5. Notes / Not Checked

- In the live `agy` run above, `pieces` stayed `[]` because the harness seeded `cl43-demo-step` via `PUT /_api/db/posts/cl43-demo-step` without `kit.py step new`, so `.kit/run/pieces/cl43-demo-step.json` was not generated; agy `pieces` tracking (`write_file` / `edit_file` `Path` and `run_command` mtime -> `pieces: [2]`, then `pieces: [1]`) is verified end-to-end against a real local `board_server.py` in `tests/test_post_gate.py::Live::test_what_an_agy_part_does_now_reaches_its_step_with_no_model_call`.
- Full 62-suite `python3 scripts/run_all_tests.py` stopped early on an unrelated pre-existing suite (`tests/test_arena_out_of_box.py::test_clerk_atomic_route_seen_pending_and_auto_sync_db`, `store.auto_sync_count == 0` under parallel load); all CL43-relevant suites were run directly and passed with 0 failures.
- `docs/prompts/cl43-the-live-line-and-loop-breaker-on-agy.md` was left untracked and no report file was committed (per K9).
